newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer Polisa abandons OTC trade plan.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer Polisa abandons OTC trade plan.

text.p: Polish insurer Polisa SA gave up its plan to seek listing both on the Warsaw bourse's main floor and on the nascent over-the-counter market and chose to trade only on the bourse, a deputy president of the company said.
"OTC market was only an idea, our real goal is the main market listing and we hope it will be possible soon," Zygfryd Kielarski said.

Polisa earlier has said it wanted to enter CTO (Centralna Tabela Ofert) OTC market without giving up its bid for bourse listing as its shareholders were keen to put the shares on the secondary market as quickly as possible.

Kielarski said Polisa decided to give up the OTC plan after the exchange's president warned on Friday he would seek to deny Polisa a bourse listing if it traded over-the-counter, saying that such a parallel listing would reduce market transparency and liquidity.
